title.zh: 将依第4184号法设立的劳工住宅的管理权由劳工部长移交给人民宅地与住房公司并为其他目的法案
title.en: An Act Transferring the Administration of the Laborers’ Dwelling Established Under Act Numbered Forty-One Hundred Eighty-Four from the Secretary of Labor to the People’s Homesite and Housing Corporation and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Transferring the Administration of the Laborers’ Dwelling Established Under Act Numbered Forty-One Hundred Eighty-Four from the Secretary of Labor to the People’s Homesite and Housing Corporation and for Other Purposes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2618_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: All functions powers and authority vested on the Secretary of Labor under Act Numbered Forty-one hundred and eighty-four, as amended, are hereby transferred to the People’s Homesite and Housing Corporation together with all the appropriations provided for in said Act.

All the lands and buildings comprising what is known as the Government Tenement Houses situated at Vitas, Tondo, Manila acquired by the Government and the administration of which is entrusted to the Secretary of Labor by virtue of said Act Numbered Forty-one hundred and eighty-four, as amended, are hereby transferred to the People’s Homesite and Housing Corporation for its administration and maintenance together with all the monies and records pertaining to said lands and buildings, and the personnel in charge thereof.
The People’s Homesite and Housing Corporation in fixing the rentals that shall be charged in these tenement houses shall take as a primary consideration the income of the tenants therein.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 22, 1960.
